# FastNoiseLite evaluation dependency
Upstream https://github.com/Auburn/FastNoiseLite, v1.1.1, exact commit 7ccfbc16eb1c932568f177d63a9ba51d89bbe516.
Unmodified Cpp/FastNoiseLite.h (upstream blob c67f2e5cec4653ebf85e9f19eec2d6ddfd8ca697) and LICENSE (upstream blob dd6df2c160a31fff4e781e9589d56bc29dabb5c0). Original copyright notices retained. No additional assets or runtime dependencies. Probe uses only two-dimensional Perlin mode with no fractal and compile flags -fwrapv -ffp-contract=off; source audit identified signed wraparound in Hash and coordinate priming and implementation-defined signed right shift in gradient hash. Other algorithms are not admitted. Fatal UBSan remains enabled; no global relaxation. Compiler/target equivalence still needs testing. Production code must not depend on this evaluation until qualified.
